observed: One blue-jacketed trader repeats in eight separate station vignettes on paper.
The top row contrasts a relaxed phone call, a tense hunch, a raised-fist celebration and a head-down slump.
The bottom row contrasts leaning boredom, a hand-to-chin pause, an urgent raised-slip call and sleep on folded arms.
Simple hair, clear hands and rounded blank heads leave the posture legible.
corrections: The chest emblem is not gold; use the Atlas emblem material once picked.
No jacket colour sits near brass, which is reserved for live readings.
A paper-plane throw keeps a curled wrist so it never reads as a salute.
The shouting pose has no mouth; posture carries the mood.
Heads are a little larger than in the references so they read at 40 pixels; the exact ratio still needs a pick.
Use the post reference's 1980s trading-station detail instead of adopting the bare beige cabinets as finished assets.
The asleep station needs a lamp visibly off; the sheet's absent lamps do not establish the state indicator.
Check the calm moods separately at small size; this image pick is not a measured 40-pixel readability result.

Colour audit 13 October: add timber support in the realized scene; this sheet has no modelled floor. Strengthen the observed desk range (about 2.05:1) and monitor range (1.760:1), lift dark jacket faces, and retain the gold-emblem correction. The sheet gives no clean front-glass sample.
